fieldNotes.location: Confirmed FedEx Ground regional sortation hub in Triad Business Park, ~493,000 sq ft on a ~125-acre site (opened 2011 at 410K sq ft, expanded 2015 to 493K sq ft). Roster coordinate landed directly on the hub building despite a 9.1 km geocode move from the listed Old Greensboro Rd address.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Controlled truck gate confirmed on the north access road off the public road. z20 satellite shows a checkpoint with painted multi-lane markings and a small booth structure straddling the entrance lanes.
fieldNotes.guardShack: Small guard-booth structure visible centered in the gate lanes in z20 imagery (footprint of ~1-2 vehicle spaces, set between in/out lanes). Standard FedEx Ground guarded hub entry.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Long curved private access road from the public road to the gate, then a deep paved approach into the yard — easily holds 3+ trucks.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide multi-lane gate apron with painted lanes and ample paved width for an express bypass.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Very large hub: dock doors on multiple wrapping faces of the central building, well over 50 — estimated ~200 total from z18 imagery. Honest overhead estimate.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Extensive trailer-parking rows surround the building on all sides, hundreds of drop trailers — clearly 50+. Estimated ~600 trailers visible / ~700 capacity.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Edge-of-town industrial business park (Triad Business Park) outside Kernersville's dense fabric, surrounded by woods and other large warehouses. Classed Rural per the small-town-industrial guidance.
fieldNotes.entryLanes: ~2 inbound lanes at the gate from painted markings; exitLanes ~2. Medium confidence on exact lane count.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: ~116 acres from the perimeter box; documented site is ~125 acres in Triad Business Park.

citations.claim: FedEx Ground opened a $100M, 410,000 sq ft hub on 125 acres at 1544 Old Greensboro Rd, Kernersville NC
FedEx Ground bought ~25 adjacent acres for expansion of the Kernersville hub

verification.rationale: Large Ground hub in expansion mode; NC Network 2.0 closures hit Durham/Raleigh/Greensboro ship centers, not this hub.
